subject.title: fix(telegram): classify unreachable-recipient errors as non-retryable in ingress drain

question: Should this PR proceed only after the exposed Telegram bot credential has been rotated and the public proof has been replaced with redacted end-to-end gateway evidence?
rationale: Credential rotation and public-proof remediation affect an external bot security boundary and cannot be safely performed or attested by a code-review automation lane.

options.title: Rotate, redact, and refresh proof
options.body: Rotate or revoke the exposed bot token, remove it from the PR body and any retained public artifacts, then add redacted gateway output proving dead-lettering after the rebase.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Pause this branch if the credential owner cannot promptly rotate the token and reproduce the behavior without publishing secrets.

recommendation.title: Rotate, redact, and refresh proof
recommendation.body: Rotate or revoke the exposed bot token, remove it from the PR body and any retained public artifacts, then add redacted gateway output proving dead-lettering after the rebase.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work on the Telegram ingress area makes this the best available routing candidate for the queue semantics after the credential owner completes remediation.
